name: Prenatal karyotyping
description: Chromosome analysis can be used in prenatal diagnosis to identify chromosomal abnormalities such as Down syndrome, Turner syndrome, and Klinefelter syndrome.

name: Sex-linked disease tracking
description: Understanding sex chromosomes provides a basis for tracking and studying diseases whose inheritance is linked to the X or Y chromosome.

name: Cancer chromosomal mapping
description: Chromosomal mapping helps researchers identify chromosomal abnormalities and genomic changes associated with cancer.

name: Plant genetics
description: Chromosome-based understanding of heredity provides a foundation for studying inheritance and genetic traits in plants.

name: Nuclear power
description: Nuclear fission provides the physical basis for nuclear power plants, where controlled nuclear chain reactions generate energy.

name: Radioisotope thermoelectric generators
description: Radioactive decay can generate electricity for spacecraft and deep-space missions through radioisotope thermoelectric generators.

name: Positron emission tomography (PET)
description: Radioisotopes and nuclear physics provide the basis for PET imaging, which uses radioactive tracers to produce functional images of the body.

name: Radiotherapy
description: Radioactive processes and radiation physics are used to target and destroy cancer cells in radiation therapy.

name: Nuclear weapons
description: The physics of nuclear fission contributed to the development of nuclear weapons.

name: Auger electron spectroscopy
description: Auger electrons can be measured to determine the elemental composition and chemical state of material surfaces.

name: Semiconductor manufacturing
description: Auger electron spectroscopy can be used to characterize semiconductor surfaces and investigate materials during manufacturing.

name: Corrosion analysis
description: Surface-analysis techniques can identify elemental changes, grain boundaries, and early oxidation processes involved in material corrosion.

name: Cosmic dust analysis
description: Auger electron spectroscopy can be used to analyze the composition and properties of extraterrestrial particles and cosmic dust.

name: Pion discovery research
description: Photographic nuclear emulsions enabled researchers to detect and study particle interactions that contributed to the discovery and investigation of pions.

name: High-energy particle accelerator research
description: Nuclear-emulsion techniques allowed researchers to visualize and map interactions of high-energy protons in particle accelerators.

name: Carbon-14 dating
description: Research into neutron interactions and nuclear processes contributed to the development of radiocarbon dating, which is used to estimate the age of once-living materials.

name: DNA structural biology
description: X-ray diffraction methods provide structural information that allows researchers to determine the three-dimensional organization of DNA and other biological molecules.

name: DNA sequencing
description: Structural and molecular understanding of DNA contributed to the development of modern approaches for studying and sequencing genetic material.

name: Human Genome Project
description: Knowledge of DNA structure and molecular biology provided foundational scientific knowledge for sequencing and interpreting the human genome.

name: Molecular virology
description: Structural analysis of RNA viruses enables researchers to understand viral architecture and molecular mechanisms.

name: Vaccine development
description: Structural and molecular studies of viruses help researchers understand pathogens and develop targeted vaccines and antiviral strategies.

name: Structure-based drug design
description: Protein and molecular structure determination enables researchers to design drugs that interact with specific molecular targets.

name: Pulsar astronomy
description: Pulsars provide precise astronomical objects for studying neutron stars, magnetic fields, stellar evolution, and extreme physical conditions.

name: Tests of general relativity
description: Precise pulsar timing allows researchers to test predictions of general relativity, including effects in binary-pulsar systems.

name: Gravitational-wave detection
description: Pulsar timing arrays use precisely timed millisecond pulsars to search for low-frequency gravitational waves.

name: Spacecraft navigation
description: The highly regular signals from pulsars can be used as natural celestial reference points for spacecraft navigation.

name: Memory research
description: Paired-associate learning experiments provide a controlled method for studying how people form, store, and retrieve associations in memory.

name: Forgetting-curve research
description: Memory experiments can be used to measure how information is retained or forgotten over time.

name: Clinical memory assessment
description: Memory-testing paradigms can contribute to assessments of cognitive function and the detection of neurological impairment.

name: Primacy and recency research
description: Paired-list experiments allow researchers to investigate how the position of information within a sequence affects recall.

name: Chromosome karyotyping
description: Chromosome counting and visualization provide a diagnostic method for identifying numerical and structural chromosomal abnormalities.

name: Prenatal genetic diagnosis
description: Chromosomal analysis can be combined with other prenatal screening and diagnostic methods to identify genetic and chromosomal conditions before birth.

name: Diagnosis of chromosomal abnormalities
description: Karyotyping and related cytogenetic methods can identify conditions involving abnormal chromosome number, translocations, and mosaicism.

name: Neuroplasticity research
description: Environmental-enrichment experiments demonstrate that experience and environmental conditions can produce measurable structural changes in the brain.

name: Brain rehabilitation research
description: Research on experience-dependent brain plasticity contributes to scientific approaches for understanding recovery and adaptation after neurological injury.

name: Aging neuroscience
description: Research demonstrating structural changes in older brains supports the study of how the brain changes and adapts throughout the lifespan.

name: Learning and cognitive development
description: Research on environmental enrichment and brain plasticity contributes to understanding how experience and environmental conditions affect learning and development.

name: Laboratory animal-care enrichment
description: Environmental-enrichment research has influenced practices designed to provide laboratory and zoo animals with more stimulating environments.

name: Gene regulation research
description: Lambda phage provides an experimental system for studying gene regulation and the molecular mechanisms controlling gene expression.

name: Lysogeny research
description: Lambda phage provides a model for studying how bacteriophages can enter and maintain a lysogenic state within bacterial cells.

name: Bacterial conjugation
description: The F factor provides the molecular basis for understanding bacterial conjugation and the transfer of genetic material between cells.

name: Horizontal gene transfer
description: Research on the F factor and bacterial conjugation helped establish mechanisms through which bacteria exchange genetic material.

name: Replica plating
description: Replica plating allows researchers to transfer hundreds of bacterial colonies while preserving their relative positions, enabling systematic screening for mutants.

name: Mutant screening
description: Replica-plating techniques allow researchers to identify bacterial colonies with specific phenotypes, including resistance to antibiotics or bacteriophages.

name: Molecular cloning
description: Bacteriophage and bacterial genetics research contributed experimental foundations for manipulating and studying DNA in molecular biology.

name: Genetic engineering
description: Understanding bacterial genetics, plasmids, gene transfer, and molecular cloning contributed to the development of genetic engineering.

name: Transposon-based gene tagging
description: Transposable elements can be used as genetic tools to identify and study the function of genes.

name: Insertional mutagenesis
description: Transposons can be inserted into genomes to disrupt genes and investigate their biological functions.

name: Functional genomics
description: Transposable elements provide tools for systematically investigating gene function and genome organization.

name: Genome evolution research
description: Transposable elements contribute to genome structure and evolution and provide a means of studying how genomes change over time.

name: Modern theoretical physics

name: Quantum mechanics

name: Quantum field theory

name: Particle physics
description: Symmetry principles and conservation laws are fundamental to the formulation and analysis of particle-physics theories.

name: Standard Model physics
description: Symmetries and associated conservation laws are central to the mathematical structure of the Standard Model.

name: General relativity

name: Commutative algebra

name: Algebraic geometry

name: Metabolic physiology

name: Exercise physiology

name: Glycogen metabolism

name: Enzyme regulation
description: Studies of glycogen phosphorylase helped establish principles of enzyme activation, inactivation, and regulation.

name: Diabetes research
description: Understanding glycogen metabolism and enzyme regulation provides foundational biochemical knowledge for studying metabolic diseases including diabetes.

name: Glycogen-storage disease research
description: Research on glycogen metabolism provides the biochemical framework for understanding disorders involving abnormal glycogen storage or breakdown.

name: Tiger population monitoring

name: Wildlife corridor conservation
description: Research on tiger habitat connectivity can identify and prioritize corridors connecting protected wildlife areas.

name: Human-wildlife conflict management
description: Ecological research and community-based conservation strategies can help address conflicts between people and wildlife.

name: Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy
description: FTIR spectroscopy uses interferometric methods to obtain detailed infrared spectra for analyzing molecular composition.

name: Planetary atmospheric analysis
description: FTIR spectroscopy can measure infrared signatures in planetary atmospheres and determine their molecular composition.

name: Infrared spectroscopy
description: Interferometric spectroscopy provides high-resolution measurements of infrared radiation and molecular spectra.

name: Scientific computing
description: Scientific computing supports numerical analysis and processing of complex astronomical and spectroscopic data.

name: Classical mathematical astronomy
description: Hypatia's scholarship helped preserve and transmit mathematical and astronomical knowledge from classical antiquity.

name: Transmission of mathematical knowledge

name: Cell culture research

name: Melanoma research

name: Cancer cell biology
description: Experimental study of cancer cells provides methods for investigating how malignant cells grow and respond to biological factors.

name: Wildlife population assessment
description: Population surveys and monitoring methods support conservation planning for endangered species.

name: Indus River dolphin conservation

name: Protected-area management
description: Population and biodiversity assessments help conservation organizations design and evaluate protected-area management strategies.

name: River dolphin conservation standards
description: Standardized conservation frameworks can be used to evaluate and improve management of river-dolphin populations.

name: Insect metamorphosis research

name: Insect-plant relationship research
description: Observations of insects feeding on specific plants contributed to understanding ecological relationships between insects and their host plants.

name: Insect life-cycle documentation

name: Botanical and zoological illustration
description: Scientific illustrations can document species morphology, life cycles, and ecological relationships for research and education.

name: Psychoanalytic theory

name: Child psychology

name: Language development research

name: Childbirth pain management

name: Menstrual health treatment

name: Preventive medicine
description: Early advocacy for preventive approaches to health and disease management.

name: Dermatological treatment

name: Midwifery and obstetric practice
